tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the board. Violet-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Every tile and pill. One step up from ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover fills, ghost buttons, the active dock item, empty bar tracks.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Rows inside a list tile and the track behind a segmented control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge on every tile, pill and row. Section header hairlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Tile and button edge on hover and while selected.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, values and body text on ground, surface, raised and sunk (14.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines and inactive controls on ground, surface, raised and sunk (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase section and readout labels on ground, surface and sunk only (4.8:1); not on raised (4.35:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with a 2px offset on every focusable element.

tokens.name: on-category
tokens.usage: Text on a filled category button. Dark text: white fails on amber, green and violet.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Overall score, tier, the statue's veins, kept days (85% or more). Never a button, icon or heading. 7.9:1 on raised.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: Behind gold readouts and the score chip.

tokens.name: business
tokens.usage: Business marks: bars, rings, chart marks, filled buttons. Validated chart colour (OKLCH L 0.67).

tokens.name: business-text
tokens.usage: Business numbers, chip text and status lines on surface and sunk (8.4:1).

tokens.name: business-tint
tokens.usage: Business chip fill and icon tile; the corner glow uses the mark colour.

tokens.name: school
tokens.usage: School marks. Never placed next to mind in a chart.

tokens.name: school-text
tokens.usage: School numbers, chip text and status lines on surface and sunk (6.5:1).

tokens.name: school-tint
tokens.usage: School chip fill and icon tile.

tokens.name: athletics
tokens.usage: Athletics marks.

tokens.name: athletics-text
tokens.usage: Athletics numbers, chip text and status lines on surface and sunk (5.7:1).

tokens.name: athletics-tint
tokens.usage: Athletics chip fill and icon tile.

tokens.name: mind
tokens.usage: Mind marks. Never placed next to school in a chart.

tokens.name: mind-text
tokens.usage: Mind numbers, chip text and status lines on surface and sunk (7.0:1).

tokens.name: mind-tint
tokens.usage: Mind chip fill and icon tile; journal entries.

tokens.name: nutrition
tokens.usage: Nutrition marks.

tokens.name: nutrition-text
tokens.usage: Nutrition numbers, chip text and status lines on surface and sunk (8.3:1).

tokens.name: nutrition-tint
tokens.usage: Nutrition chip fill and icon tile.

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: Completion 1 to 24%: calendar cells and completion bars. Day number in ink.

tokens.name: ramp-2
tokens.usage: Completion 25 to 49%. Day number in ink (4.7:1).

tokens.name: ramp-3
tokens.usage: Completion 50 to 69%. Day number in on-category.

tokens.name: ramp-4
tokens.usage: Completion 70 to 84%. Day number in on-category.

tokens.name: ramp-5
tokens.usage: Completion 85% and up, with a gold outline around each streak run. Day number in on-category.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The header clock (time by the 4 AM day).

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The overall score in the hero tile, in gold.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero tile title and the tier name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Full planned session logged in Lifta
styles.usage: Goal text, list rows, journal entries.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Tile subtitles, status lines, dock labels.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Section headers and readout labels only, in ink-label.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The number in a readout tile, in its category's text colour.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: A skill's score in the tile corner; ring centres.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Times, counts and values inside pills and rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list tile; gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The board gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on the phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; page gutter on the laptop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Header to first section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented control buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon tiles, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Every tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips and status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Every tile at rest: lit top edge, dark bottom edge, a close shadow and a long soft one.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Interactive tiles on hover, the dock and dialogs.

tokens.name: dock-lift
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for the dock; prefer shadow-lift.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The bottom bar on a tile.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Status dots.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: The tinted square holding a tile's icon.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Gauge rings.

tokens.name: ring-sm
tokens.usage: The icon ring on a rack card.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on the phone.

tokens.name: glow-corner
tokens.usage: Corner glow at rest.

tokens.name: glow-hover
tokens.usage: Corner glow on hover and while the tile's goal pulses.

tokens.name: tint-chip
tokens.usage: The alpha used for every category tint.
